data.name: Zadok
data.gender_notes: Zadok is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word 'zdq' meaning 'righteousness' or 'justice'. In the Old Testament, Zadok was a priest who served in the temple of Jerusalem during the reigns of David and Solomon. The name Zadok carries the meaning “Justice, Righteousness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Zadok usually hope their child will grow to embody justice, righteousness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Zadok belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Justice, Righteousness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zadok total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: צדוק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: במקרא, צדוק היה כהן גדול, מכהן הטהור, הראשון והאחרון, שעמד נגד שלמיהו ובניו. השם צדוק נחשב למזוהה עם צדק. לפי התלמוד, צדוק היה שמו של אחד מבניו של צדוק, או של נצרו.

in_greek.name: Ζαδοκ
in_greek.meaning: ἡγέτης τῶν ἱερέων, μνημόσυνα ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ, δικαίως
in_greek.long_meaning: ἐν τῇ Ἁγία Γραφῇ, Ζαδοκ ἦν ἱερέας τῶν ἱερέων, τὸν ὁποῖον ὁ Θεός ἔθεσε ὡς ἡγέτη τῶν ἱερέων. οὗτος ὁ ὄνομα Ζαδοκ συνδέεται με τὴν ἰδέα τῆς δικαιοσύνης. Κατά τὴν Ἑβραϊκή μαρτυρία, ὁ Ζαδοκ ἦταν οἱ υἱοὶ Ζαδοκ, ἕνας τῶν Ἱεροθεόντων.

in_latin.name: Zadok
in_latin.meaning: sacerdotum princeps, memoriam Dei habens, iustus
in_latin.long_meaning: In Biblia, Zadok fuit sacerdos maior, qui ab Deo constituendus erat sacerdotum princeps. Nomen Zadok est coniunctum cum notione iustitiae. Secundum testimonia Hebraica, Zadok fuit filii Zadok, unus ex Hieroteontibus.

in_english.name: Zadok
in_english.meaning: high priest, remembered by God, righteous
in_english.long_meaning: In the Bible, Zadok was the high priest, set by God as the leader of the priests. The name Zadok is associated with the concept of righteousness. According to Hebrew testimony, Zadok was the son of Zadok, one of the High Priests. Zadok is also mentioned in 1 Kings 1:32-40, 1 Chronicles 15:11, 16:39, 23:6, 24:3, 2 Chronicles 29:11, 30:3, and 2 Samuel 8:17, 15:24, 17:15, 18:19, and 20:26, 24:2, 25:18. In Christian tradition, Zadok is seen as a righteous and faithful priest who stood against King Solomon and his sons. He is also associated with the concept of justice and righteousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zadok carries a significant cultural impact, being rooted in the rich history and traditions of the Old Testament. Zadok was one of the most faithful and respected priests during the monarchy, keeping the temple and its rituals operating smoothly through tumultuous times. Even today, the name Zadok is a reminder of the incredible role the priesthood played in ancient Israelite culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Zadok signifies the essential qualities of righteousness and justice. These values are central to the Christian faith, and Zadok can serve as a reminder that living a life dedicated to these virtues is a worthy and noble pursuit. Christians may also find inspiration in the resilience and determination of the biblical figure Zadok, who remained devoted to his faith and duties despite the challenges he faced.
